# xEdit record definitions

`wbDefinitionsFNV.pas`, `wbDefinitionsFO3.pas` and `wbDefinitionsFO4.pas`,
copied unmodified from `Core/` of [xEdit](https://github.com/TES5Edit/TES5Edit).
They are under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 (`LICENSE.txt`).

The converter reads the condition function table and the actor value names
from them (`tools/dialog/tes4_ctda_dump.py`, `fo4_import/spike/conditions.py`).
They are not compiled.
